# pyzstd SeekableZstdFile: frame size and first-read cost

[Preregistered protocol and pre-measurement host amendment](CALIBRATION.md) · [Host and wheel receipt](enwik8-L3/run.json) · [Matched-host C receipt](c-baseline/enwik8-L3/acecore.json)

Archives are resident in RAM; each pair uses a new io.BytesIO and SeekableZstdFile. Open is timed separately and excluded from first-read seek+read. Repeat is the immediate same seek+read. Both returned byte strings and lengths were checked against the source outside timing.

Each percentile is the median of five per-repeat nearest-rank statistics (1000 requests each). Latencies retain integer-nanosecond precision. Archive bytes include the complete seek table; size delta is relative to the 64 MiB archive at the same corpus and level. Default means max_frame_content_size was omitted (1 GiB; one corpus frame).

Measured host: AMD EPYC 4344P 8-Core Processor; affinity [0]; Ubuntu 22.04.5 LTS; CPython 3.12.16; pyzstd 0.20.0; linked zstd 1.5.7; governor schedutil. Absolute times apply to ace-core and this resident-archive workload. Parent start, resume and end process observations are retained as context. Every accepted timed repeat used the blocking shared /run/lock/ovh-bench.lock and recorded date -u, raw /proc/loadavg and nproc at both boundaries. Both one-minute load averages were ≤ the applicable policy threshold: 1.0 for the 45 immutably retained C repeats, 2.0 for all new repeats. The retained 45 predate per-core monitoring and have no backfilled /proc/stat data. New v2 boundaries retain raw per-core counters and derived busy/total jiffies for CPUs other than CPU 0. CPU utilization is observational and never affects the load decision. LOADED attempts are retained and excluded. Other process activity alone is not an exclusion criterion under OVH-BENCH. The same pinned core was used for the new C baseline. Historical HW-GIFT-1 host timings remain separate.

1 of 520 logical repeats were retaken; 0 active-policy LOADED attempts were excluded. Separately, 3 historical LOADED attempts at the explicitly reset key remain excluded and preserved. Each active attempt budget has at most three attempts; only the formerly blocked key received the expressly authorized fresh budget. The first CLEAN result was selected and never retimed; the approved 45 CLEAN dictionaries and raw files remain byte-identical to commit 8022d962. All raw attempts, including their lock/load receipts and stdout/stderr, are retained in each checkpoint's attempts.tar.gz and attempts.json. The two earlier whole-trial rejections (110 attempts) remain excluded and are not counted in this fresh trial.
